summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on updating and reaggregating facility master data due to changes in the Master Namah facility. Two clusters were reportedly decommissioned, and a new cluster was established.

Someone requested that [me] rewrite/update session data for May. This task is expected to take about two hours.

The conversation confirmed that these changes affect aggregation, requiring all three masters to be specified during reaggregation. It was determined that the best approach might be to aggregate the entire company's data rather than just specific facilities.

[me] later provided specific `facility_master_num` values (44699, 44705, 44700) for reaggregation, or alternatively suggested aggregating the whole company.
decisions: Update session data for May is required.
Reaggregate facility master data using specific facility_master_num (44699, 44705, 44700) or aggregate the entire company.
action_items: [me] to rewrite/update session data for May.
[me] to perform the facility master reaggregation using specified numbers or full company aggregation.
